title: Muon matrix LR bump
description: Increased MATRIX_LR (Muon optimizer LR for matrix params) from 0.04 to 0.06, all else unchanged.
reflection: val_bpb 1.012971 vs baseline 1.014027, a small ~0.001 improvement that's likely close to run-to-run noise but directionally positive. Not a strong result on its own. Worth a follow-up sweep (e.g. 0.05, 0.08) if the cell has spare runs after the depth sweeps settle, but I wouldn't prioritize it over a stronger idea. Chose this axis specifically to avoid duplicating the depth-sweep proposals (#2 DEPTH=12, #3/#4 DEPTH=6) that two other agents were already running this round.
